text.en-US: Map: Phantom Edge barriers (with the edge each needs), locked and one-way doors, quest objectives, NPCs, area exits and Challenge Locations.

text.en-US: Interactive map of every area: bells, collectibles, equipment, notes, materials, Remnant Dust and bosses, with what each spot holds.
text.zh-CN: 全区域互动地图：铃铛、收集品、装备、文书、材料、意识尘埃与首领，并标明每个点位能获得的物品。
